subject: general
question: Which of the following groups received Personal Protective Equipment kits from the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment during National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem Day in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sewer and septic tank workers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** organized the **National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) Day** to celebrate the achievements and safety milestones of sanitation workers.
 
• During this event, **Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) kits** were distributed specifically to **Sewer and Septic Tank Workers (SSWs)** to safeguard them from occupational hazards associated with hazardous cleaning. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The distribution of these kits is a critical component of the **NAMASTE scheme**, which aims to eliminate the practice of manual cleaning of sewers and septic tanks by providing **safety gear** and **mechanized equipment**.
 
• The event highlighted the government's commitment to ensuring **zero fatalities** in sanitation work and improving the **social security** and **dignity** of these workers.
